correctness.rationale: The max-difference oscillation argument gives the upper bound. A block of 12q unit entries followed by 12q alternating 3/4 and zero entries has exactly 4q-3 tested edges where odd vertices have zero response and even vertices have response at least epsilon/2. Those statements follow from strict prefix-average comparisons, valid at every q, and give the finite n lower bound after zero padding. On Z, the perturbation has two variation jumps, and positive homogeneity yields arbitrarily small input pairs with unbounded output/input ratios. A standalone exact Fraction checker verifies q=1..5, with analytic proof carrying the general case.
